newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Cereals & Oils Exchange to shorten trade.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Cereals & Oils Exchange to shorten trade.

text.p: The Shanghai Cereals & Oils Exchange changes its afternoon trading times on Monday to allow for the official opening ceremony for its new building in the Pudong zone, an exchange official said on Monday.
The exchange will trade for 30 minutes from 3 pm to 3.30 pm (0700-0730 GMT) rather than the usual 1 pm to 2 pm (0500-0600 GMT), the official said.
The exchange began business at its new home in the Pudong zone to the east of Shanghai's city centre on December 18.
